text:
taylor: hit an incident in us-west-2 — several trainer pods stuck Pending, nodepool flapping and autoscaler not stabilizing. GPU quota errors in pod events.

oncall-bot: incident opened: INC-2026-4925 · paging infra-lead-josh · severity: P2

marc: quick look — looks like a training job leaking memory and pinning GPU, nodes go NotReady after driver hits an OOM. pods restart loop -> node stays saturated.

sophia: cluster-autoscaler logs show immediate scale-up followed by scale-down candidates. probably scale-down policy racing with pod scheduling.

nora: kubectl get pod snippet:
```
NAME                  READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
trainer-hw-leak-5     0/1     Pending   12         9m   (0/1 nodes are available: Insufficient gpu)
trainer-batch-2       0/1     Pending   0          7m   (0/1 nodes are available: Insufficient memory)
```

infra-lead-josh: ok taking lead. immediate mitigations: 1) bump nodepool min from 8 -> 11, 2) cordon affected nodes, 3) evict runaway trainer pod. initiating terraform/console now.

devops-cli: terraform plan/apply kicked: plan id t-apply-195 · apply in progress (2/3 providers ready) · ETA ~3m

marc: to evict safely we should force-delete trainer-hw-leak. it's holding NVidia device and blocking scheduling. command I will run:
```
kubectl delete pod trainer-hw-leak-5 -n training --grace-period=0 --force
```

k8s-autoscaler-bot: FYI — scale-up suppressed earlier due to taint mismatch in node template (taint: gpu=experimental:NoSchedule). Removing taint from template will allow new nodes to accept scheduled pods.

taylor: patching training kustomize to set resources.limits.memory=12Gi and backoffLimit=2 to avoid runaway restarts. Will push quick patch.

sophia: monitoring node events — new nodes are registering and becoming Ready. scheduling backlog decreasing.

nora: after evict, trainer-hw-leak restarted elsewhere? anyone see reschedule?

marc: trainer-hw-leak gone, pods moved to new nodes, GPU appears to be allocated properly. keeping watch for driver stability.

infra-lead-josh: nodepool min bumped successfully, nodes ready. keeping override for 2 hours to avoid oscillation.

taylor: post-incident TODOs: 1) add pod-level GPU/memory limit enforcement for training namespace, 2) tweak autoscaler scaleDownUnneededTime and unready node handling, 3) add alert for sustained per-node GPU memory pressure, 4) evaluate reserved capacity window for daily scheduled jobs to avoid churn and cost spikes.

sophia: noted — I'll open follow-up tickets for autoscaler policy and alerting.

infra-lead-josh: cost note — holding extra nodes ~+0.9k/day. will notify finance for temporary budget approval.

oncall-bot: incident mitigated · status: resolved (mitigation: bumped min nodes, evicted runaway pod, patched job limits, removed taint) · closing thread. :white_check_mark:
